input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 already meets our preferred position in full. § 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free right to assign to an Affiliate (as defined in § 1.1) or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, subject only to prompt notice and assignee assumption. § 24.2 binds Vendor asymmetrically in our favour: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (reasonableness qualified only by capability/financial standing), and never to a direct Customer competitor. § 24.3's residual consent requirement is expressly limited to "other assignments," so it does not undercut the § 24.1 carve-out. § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, and requires cooperation with successor administrative changes. § 13.3 aligns by permitting licence transfer to an Affiliate or successor in connection with a Section 24 permitted assignment. A document-wide search found no deemed-assignment trigger or other change-of-control right favouring Vendor; § 9.2 is a standard mutual insolvency right that expressly excludes lawful reorganizations. No redline required.
